anchors.ownedWork: SELECT id FROM work_items WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedAssignments: SELECT id FROM assignments WHERE root_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork) OR work_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork)
anchors.ownedSessions: SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedEvents: SELECT id FROM events WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedOperations: SELECT id FROM operations WHERE root_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork) OR assignment_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedAssignments) UNION SELECT operation_id FROM events WHERE project_id=?1 AND kind='CommandDecided' AND operation_id IS NOT NULL
anchors.ownedDecisionApprovals: SELECT id FROM decision_approvals WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedConventionImports: SELECT operation_id AS id FROM convention_imports WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedProviderAttempts: SELECT id FROM provider_attempts WHERE session_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedSessions)
anchors.ownedUsageAttempts: SELECT attempt_id AS id FROM usage_attempts WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedKnowledgeWrites: SELECT write_id AS id FROM knowledge_writes WHERE scope_key='project:'||?1
anchors.ownedConventions: SELECT DISTINCT convention_id AS id FROM convention_versions WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedConventionIndexes: SELECT generation_id AS id FROM convention_indexes WHERE convention_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedConventions)
anchors.ownedConventionEmbeddingInputs: SELECT request_id AS id FROM convention_embedding_inputs WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedSchedules: SELECT id FROM schedules WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedJobRuns: SELECT id FROM job_runs WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedClaims: SELECT id FROM knowledge_claims WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedEntities: SELECT id FROM knowledge_entities WHERE project_id=?1
anchors.ownedProjectResources: SELECT id FROM resources WHERE scope='project' AND project_id=?1

candidatePredicates.assignments: root_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork) OR work_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork)
candidatePredicates.blockers: root_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork) OR assignment_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedAssignments) OR operation_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedOperations)
candidatePredicates.job_actions: schedule_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedSchedules) OR run_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedJobRuns)
candidatePredicates.job_run_links: run_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedJobRuns) OR root_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork)
candidatePredicates.knowledge_deliveries: claim_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedClaims) OR session_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedSessions)
candidatePredicates.knowledge_history: (target_kind='Claim' AND target_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedClaims)) OR (target_kind='Entity' AND target_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedEntities))
candidatePredicates.queue_entries: root_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork) OR operation_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedOperations) OR event_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedEvents)
candidatePredicates.resource_grants: operation_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedOperations) OR resource_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedProjectResources)
candidatePredicates.session_events: session_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedSessions) OR event_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedEvents)
candidatePredicates.stop_coverage: root_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork) OR operation_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedOperations)
candidatePredicates.usage_changes: attempt_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedUsageAttempts) OR feature_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork)
candidatePredicates.work_dependencies: work_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork) OR prerequisite_id IN(SELECT id FROM ownedWork)
